remarks: Welcome to Wolfpit II condominiums, three levels of amazing potential to make this townhouse shine. Spacious 2-bedrooms with generous closet space, shared full bathroom with tub and shower upstairs. Main floor has galley kitchen with large living/dining room space, powder room, closet and walkout deck. Downstairs is large laundry area and room with endless opportunities. Make it an office, guest space, playroom, gym, storage, the list goes on. Additional storage in basement behind rec room. Two parking spaces included and low common charges at $317 per month. Minutes or a short walk to shopping and transportation, highways. Easy updates to make this condo shine like new.
